requirements.text: Create a new MechanicRegistrationPage component at frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationPage.tsx. This is a standalone full page (not a modal) with the following form fields: Full Name (text, required), Phone Number (tel, required), Email (email, optional), Service Type (dropdown: Plumber, Electrician, Fan/Cooler Repair, AC Repair, Mechanic, required), Experience (dropdown: Less than 1 year, 1-3 years, 3-5 years, 5+ years, required), Address in Mahipalpur (textarea, required), Age (number, optional), Preferred Area (dropdown: Mahipalpur Extension, Village, Aerocity, Other, optional), Why want to join? (textarea, optional). The form must POST to https://formsubmit.co/pandeyxkanha@gmail.com with these hidden fields: _subject='👨‍🔧 New Mechanic Registration', _template='table', _captcha='false', _next='https://quickrepair-84g.caffeine.xyz/mechanic-thankyou.html', and a honeypot _honey field (display:none). On form submit (before redirect), show a full-screen GPay-style success overlay with animated green checkmark SVG and play the ascending C-E-G chime using the existing playSuccessSound utility, then after ~2 seconds allow the formsubmit redirect to proceed. Submit button text: '📝 Register as Mechanic', background: #ff8c42, hover scale 1.05. Page styling must match website theme: dark background (#0a2b3c), orange (#ff8c42), yellow (#FFD700), mobile-friendly.

quotes: Submit होने पर GPay-style success animation (green checkmark + sound)

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /mechanic-registration shows the registration form page
All specified fields are present with correct input types
Required fields show validation errors if left empty on submit
Form submits via POST to https://formsubmit.co/pandeyxkanha@gmail.com
All hidden fields (_subject, _template, _captcha, _next, _honey) are present
On submit, a full-screen success overlay with animated green checkmark appears
playSuccessSound() is called on successful submission
Submit button is orange (#ff8c42) and scales on hover
Page is fully mobile-responsive

requirements.text: Fix the admin panel authorization issue: in the backend (main.mo), the 'addService' (and editService/deleteService) functions currently return an unauthorized error for the admin. Audit the role-based access control logic — the admin principal check must correctly identify the logged-in admin and permit service CRUD operations. Ensure the admin password session stored in AdminPage.tsx frontend state correctly pairs with whatever backend auth mechanism is used (or if the backend uses caller-based auth, ensure the frontend passes the authenticated actor). Services added/edited/deleted via admin must be persisted in backend stable storage.

quotes: 'Unauthorized User' error fix होगा — services add होंगी
jab add karo to bolta hai unauthorised user

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a new service from /admin without getting 'Unauthorized User' error
Admin can edit and delete existing services
Added services persist after page refresh

requirements.text: Services added via the admin panel must appear on the website's ServicesSection. Currently ServicesSection.tsx renders five hardcoded services. Replace the hardcoded list with a dynamic fetch from the backend using the existing React Query hooks (e.g., useServices or equivalent). If no such query exists, add a getServices query in useQueries.ts and a corresponding getServices() query function in backend/main.mo that returns the stored services list. ServiceCard should render dynamically fetched services alongside (or replacing) any static defaults.

quotes: Services add होने के बाद website पर भी दिखेंगी
service add kar raha hu vo bhi nahi ho raha hai

acceptanceCriteria: Services added in the admin panel appear in the ServicesSection on the homepage
If no services are stored in backend, a reasonable fallback (empty state or default services) is shown
ServicesSection re-fetches when services are updated

requirements.text: Fix the admin panel to display mechanic registration details. Since mechanic registrations are submitted via formsubmit.co (external service) and not stored in the ICP backend, add a mechanism to also store mechanic registration data in the backend. Add a submitMechanicRegistration(name, phone, email, serviceType, experience, address, age, preferredArea, whyJoin) public shared func in main.mo that stores registrations in a stable array/list. Add a getMechanicRegistrations() admin-only query func that returns all registrations. In AdminPage.tsx, add a 'Mechanic Registrations' tab/section that fetches and displays all registrations with columns: Full Name, Phone, Email, Service Type, Experience, Address, Age, Preferred Area, Why Join. In MechanicRegistrationPage, after the form is built for formsubmit.co, also call submitMechanicRegistration() on the backend canister (fire-and-forget or alongside the form POST) so data is captured in the admin panel.

quotes: Mechanic registrations की पूरी details दिखेंगी (name, mobile, email, service type, address, etc.)
admin panel me user ka to koi bhi data nahi dikh raha

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel /admin shows a 'Mechanic Registrations' section with all submitted registrations
Each registration shows: Full Name, Phone, Email, Service Type, Experience, Address, Age, Preferred Area, Why Join
New mechanic registrations submitted via the form appear in the admin panel
Only admin can view mechanic registrations (auth-protected)
